Projects

Dynamism-v1

DYNA-1 was the first ever demonstration of a end-to-end robot learning policy robustly performing a task over 24 hours. This project was the combined effort of the entire team at Dyna Robotics.

Layer-wise Preconditioners & Provable Feature Learning

We study layer-wise preconditioners in a (seemingly benign) setting where SGD fails and derive principled insights into their effectiveness. This project was lead by Thomas Zhang and featured at ICML 2025.

Decision Making Diffusion Models

Given a diffusion trajectory and some set of features in the final sample, can we ascribe a timeline for feature generation using some form of mechanistic interpretability? Considering the variance of a final sample of the diffusion process conditioned on intermediate points, we answer yes.

TyPorch

This is a homebrewed C++ deep learning compiler that lets you design your own sequential models and run optimization algorithms such as stochastic gradient descent. Check out the repo for more!
